iti5:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti5:2.1: Ekadhammaṃ bhikkhave pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāya. Katamaṃ ekadhammaṃ? Makkhaṃ bhikkhave ekadhammaṃ pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāyā-ti. Etamatthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti5:3.1: Yena makkhena makkhāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ makkhaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti5:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||5||
